soundtrack.music: High-energy game-show countdown: fast ticking hi-hats, three huge rising synth stabs for 3-2-1, a bouncy electro-pop groove under each answer, a celebratory stinger and claps at the end. Around 128 BPM, fun and exciting. No vocals.

cover.title: Soracak kimse yok mu? Hesap açmadan sor.

rounds.answer: Hesap açarsan hedefine ve son denemene göre plan çıkarırım.
